## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug lintDebug -PlintNewApiOnly` passes
- [ ] New strings in English (`values/`) and Russian (`values-ru/`), in the screen's own `strings_<area>.xml`
- [ ] A bullet in the top section of `CHANGELOG.md`, if behaviour changes
- [ ] Go or a patch changed: patches regenerated by `appctr/patches/recreate_patches.sh`, `appctr/build.sh` run, `go test -ldflags=-checklinkname=0` on the touched packages
- [ ] Tried on a device <!-- model, Android version -->
- [ ] No secrets: no keystore, setup key, token, password or real peer name in the code, logs or screenshots
